ui.expected_result: The Service Report Type dropdown is visible and interactable.

ui.title: Verify Internal Only toggle is visible and interactable

steps_summary: Sign in as any authorized role.
Navigate to the Create Service Report form.
Verify the Internal Only toggle is visible.
ui.expected_result: The Internal Only toggle is visible and interactable.

industry_best_practice.title: Validate whitespace-only input in required fields
industry_best_practice.description: Ensure that whitespace-only input is treated as invalid in required fields.
steps_summary: Sign in as any authorized role.
Navigate to the Create Service Report form.
Enter whitespace-only input in required fields.
industry_best_practice.expected_result: The form submission fails with a validation error for whitespace-only input.

industry_best_practice.title: Test SQL/script injection in text fields
industry_best_practice.description: Ensure text fields are protected against SQL/script injection.
steps_summary: Sign in as any authorized role.
Navigate to the Create Service Report form.
Enter SQL/script injection code in text fields.
industry_best_practice.expected_result: The form submission fails, and the system is protected against SQL/script injection.

post_submission_state.title: Verify SR visibility based on Internal Only toggle
post_submission_state.description: Ensure SR visibility is correctly set based on the Internal Only toggle.
steps_summary: Sign in as any authorized role.
Navigate to the Create Service Report form.
Select SR Type and toggle Internal Only as desired.
Sign out and sign in as a Customer User.
Attempt to view the created SR.
post_submission_state.expected_result: The SR is visible to the Customer User only if the Internal Only toggle was off.

journeys.journey: From the Service Reports List Page

cases.entry_point: From the Service Reports List Page
cases.title: Create External SR from SR List
cases.description: Service Manager creates an external SR from the Service Reports List page.
preconditions: Service Manager has SR create permission for the ticket's department.
steps_summary: Navigate to the Service Reports module.
Enter SR Name and confirm today's date.
Search for and select a Ticket.
cases.expected_result: SR is created in To Do status with (External) chip visible.

cases.entry_point: From the Service Reports List Page
cases.title: Create Internal SR from SR List
cases.description: Service Manager creates an internal SR from the Service Reports List page.
preconditions: Service Manager has SR create permission for the ticket's department.
steps_summary: Navigate to the Service Reports module.
Search for and select a Ticket.
cases.expected_result: SR is created in To Do status with (Internal) chip. CU cannot see this SR.

cases.entry_point: From the Service Reports List Page
cases.title: Service Manager accesses Create SR action
cases.description: Service Manager with appropriate permissions can access and initiate the Create SR action from the SR List.
preconditions: Service Manager has SR create permission for at least one department.
steps_summary: Navigate to the Service Reports module.
Verify the Create button is visible and enabled.
cases.expected_result: Create button is visible and enabled for the Service Manager.

cases.entry_point: all_entry_points
cases.title: Unauthenticated user cannot access Create SR URL
cases.description: An unauthenticated user attempts to access the Create SR URL directly and is blocked.
steps_summary: Navigate to the Create SR URL without logging in.
cases.expected_result: User receives a 'Not Authorized' error or is redirected to the login page.

cases.entry_point: From the Service Reports List Page
cases.title: SR creation against non-terminal ticket
cases.description: Service Manager creates an SR against a non-terminal ticket, adhering to business rule BR-02.
preconditions: Service Manager has SR create permission.
Non-terminal ticket is available.
steps_summary: Navigate to the Service Reports module.
Search for and select a non-terminal Ticket.
Complete the SR form and click Save.
cases.expected_result: SR is successfully created against the non-terminal ticket.

cases.entry_point: From the Service Reports List Page
cases.title: Attempt to create SR for Closed ticket
cases.description: Service Manager attempts to create an SR for a Closed ticket, which should not be possible.
preconditions: Service Manager has SR create permission.
steps_summary: Navigate to the Service Reports module.
Attempt to search for and select a Closed Ticket.
cases.expected_result: Closed tickets do not appear in the Ticket dropdown; SR creation is blocked.

cases.entry_point: From the Service Reports List Page
cases.title: Verify post-creation state of External SR
cases.description: Verify the state and visibility of an SR after successful creation as External.
preconditions: Service Manager has created an External SR.

cases.expected_result: SR is in To Do status with (External) chip visible and listed in the SR list.
